title: Small steps: Information before consequence
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use curiosity to find the barrier, perspective or missing information before deciding the response.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: ask one neutral question that can produce useful information
principle: Create a safer path to truthful information and proportionate repair.
nextSentence: Honesty and repair still matter. First, ask one neutral question that can produce useful information.
keyLearning: Create a safer path to truthful information and proportionate repair.
